title: THE POSTCARD TOUR
author: A tiny demo of rooms drawn from image URLs (photos from Wikimedia Commons)
intro:
A short demo: every room here uses a photograph loaded from a URL instead of vector art. If a picture can't load, the room's vector "art" is drawn instead.

Your aunt has sent you on a postcard tour of Europe. Find the three stamps and post your card from the castle.
help: Try LOOK, TAKE STAMP, EXAMINE STONES, and the directions N/S/E/W. PUT STAMP ON CARD, then POST CARD at the castle.

stonehenge.name: Stonehenge
stonehenge.desc: Great grey sarsen stones stand in a ring on Salisbury Plain, as they have for some five thousand years. A road leads east - to a ferry, and the continent.

hallstatt.name: Hallstatt
hallstatt.desc: A tiny Austrian village clings to the shore of a mirror-still lake beneath wooded mountains. A church spire rises above the rooftops. Roads lead west and north.

castle.name: Neuschwanstein
castle.desc: A fairy-tale castle of white stone and slender towers perches on a crag above a gorge. Beside the gate is a bright yellow postbox. The road leads south.

card.name: postcard
card.desc: A picture postcard addressed to your aunt. It needs three stamps.

stamp1.name: British stamp
stamp1.here: A red British stamp is caught in the grass at the foot of a stone.

stamp2.name: Austrian stamp
stamp2.here: A blue Austrian stamp flutters on the jetty.

stamp3.name: German stamp
stamp3.here: A green German stamp lies by the castle gate.

stones.name: stones
stones.desc: Lichen-spotted sarsens, some capped with lintels. Nobody is quite sure why they were built.

lake.name: lake
lake.desc: The lake is so still the village appears twice.

postbox.name: postbox
postbox.desc: A bright yellow Deutsche Post box.

do.win: You drop the postcard into the yellow box. Somewhere, an aunt will be very pleased. That's the end of this little demo - now try loading any adventure JSON from a URL!

actions.else: The card needs all three stamps on it first. (PUT STAMP ON CARD)
